name: Reaper Extinction procs off direct Physical damage and grants the buff (#2171)
contract: Extinction 573039 reads 'Direct Physical damage dealt now has a 5% chance to grant you Extinction for $560414d. Chance to trigger this effect is increased by 10% for each Reaped Soul active.'

Its only DBC effect is aura 42 (SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL) triggering the Stack Adder 520501, but the record's ProcTypeMask is 0, so without spell_proc/spell_script_names rows the proc has no event to hook.

rev_20260920_11_reaper_extinction_proc.sql (already on origin/main via merged PR #4280, commit 85b231bc0) supplies ProcFlags 20 (melee auto attack | melee-class spell damage), SchoolMask 1 (Physical), SpellPhaseMask 2 (hit) and binds spell_ascension_reaper_extinction, which rolls BaseChance 5 + ChancePerSoul 10 per Reaped Soul 500363 stack.

Reaped Soul 500363's own DBC StackAmount is 3 (not 10, corrected from the original commit's premise), so the roll is 5 + 10*3 = 35%. Repeated melee auto attacks give many independent trials: over a 45 s window at roughly one swing every ~2 s (~22 swings), the false-failure probability is 0.65^22, well under 0.1%.

steps.label: Let level scaling and login settle

A melee auto attack lands on the hostile target
Extinction buff is granted from repeated direct Physical hits (~22 trials at 35% each, false-failure well under 0.1%)
